components.name: Button
components.description: Hairline button used for Tags and Load comments.
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; height:40px; padding:0 16px; font-family:var(--font-headline); font-size:0.9375rem; font-weight:700; color:var(--ink); background:transparent; border:1px solid var(--rule); border-radius:var(--radius); cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 150ms; } .ds-btn:hover { background:var(--surface); border-color:var(--ink-3); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Link fill
components.description: Primary text link: accent bar that fills the word on hover.
components.css: .ds-link { font-family:var(--font-headline); font-weight:700; color:var(--ink); text-decoration:none; background:linear-gradient(var(--accent),var(--accent)) 0 100% / 100% 2px no-repeat; padding-bottom:2px; transition:background-size 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 150ms; } .ds-link:hover { background-size:100% 100%; color:var(--accent-ink); } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Tag
components.description: Tag chip with optional count; current tag gets an accent border and soft fill.
components.css: .ds-tag { display:inline-flex; gap:6px; align-items:baseline; font-size:0.8125rem; color:var(--ink-2); text-decoration:none; border:1px solid var(--rule); border-radius:var(--radius); padding:2px 8px; transition:border-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-tag span { color:var(--ink-3); } .ds-tag:hover { border-color:var(--accent); color:var(--ink); } .ds-tag-current { border-color:var(--accent); background:var(--accent-soft); color:var(--ink); }

components.name: Search field
components.description: Surface field with an accent focus ring.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="search" placeholder="Search articles and photos">
components.css: .ds-input { width:100%; height:44px; padding:0 16px; font-size:0.9375rem; color:var(--ink); background:var(--surface); border:1px solid var(--rule); border-radius:var(--radius); } .ds-input::placeholder { color:var(--ink-3); } .ds-input:focus { outline:none; border-color:var(--accent); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft); }

components.name: Nav
components.description: Header links; current page in ink with a 2px accent underline; current route in accent.
components.html: HomeArticlesPhotosTagsOfficialCasual
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; gap:32px; align-items:center; font-size:0.9375rem; } .ds-nav > a { color:var(--ink-2); text-decoration:none; padding:4px 0; } .ds-nav > a:hover { color:var(--ink); } .ds-nav > a[aria-current='page'] { color:var(--ink); box-shadow:inset 0 -2px 0 var(--accent); } .ds-route { display:flex; gap:16px; font-family:var(--font-headline); font-weight:700; } .ds-route a { color:var(--ink-3); text-decoration:none; } .ds-route a[aria-current='true'] { color:var(--accent); }

narrative.overview:
Still, bright text on a front plane over a deep indigo field. Behind it, two flat line grids sit at different depths: the near plane has large, brighter cells and moves further with scroll and pointer; the far plane has small, dim cells and moves a third as much. Nothing else decorates the page. The site is a profile and a reading surface, so the grids are scenery: faint behind the text column, full strength only where nothing is being read.

The system is dark only and deliberately small: one ground hue, three ink levels, one accent per route. Official and Casual share every rule and differ only in accent and copy.
keyCharacteristics: Deep indigo ground, never pure black or neutral grey.
Two moving grid planes as the only scenery; quiet on reading pages.
One accent per route, spent on state, not decoration.
Heavy Red Hat Display for names and titles; calm Red Hat Text for reading.
Square-ish corners (2px) and 1px rules; no cards, no shadows on content.

rules.name: The One Hue Rule
rules.body: Every neutral is the ground hue at a different lightness and chroma. A new grey is a defect; derive it from `--ground-*` instead.

rules.name: The Spent Accent Rule
rules.body: The accent marks state (current page, current route, current role, focus, link) and code keywords. It never fills a section, tints a background, or glows.

rules.name: The Two Accents Rule
rules.body: The palette is the ground scale plus two accents. The other route's accent appears only in code strings.

rules.name: The Mono Is For Code Rule
rules.body: Red Hat Mono appears in code blocks, inline code and the ⌘K key cap. Dates, labels and numbers use Display with tabular figures.

rules.name: The Front Plane Rule
rules.body: Text never moves with the scenery. Only the grids respond to scroll, pointer and route changes; content enters with one short fade.

rules.name: The Still Under Reduced Motion Rule
rules.body: With `prefers-reduced-motion`, drift, parallax, the route pan and the timeline grow-in all stop; the grids stay as a static texture.

dos: **Do** change the look by editing the PRIMITIVES block in `css/tokens.css` (or by exporting from `design/index.html`), not by editing components.
**Do** use the semantic utilities (`bg-ground`, `bg-surface`, `border-rule`, `text-ink`, `text-ink-2`, `text-ink-3`, `text-accent`) in new markup.
**Do** keep reading text at the 68ch measure, left-aligned.
**Do** use the shared `Arrow` SVG for arrows next to text.
donts: **Don't** add a light theme or a theme toggle; the site is dark only.
**Don't** introduce a third accent, gradients, glows or colored panels.
**Don't** put cards, shadows or rounded containers around list items or content.
**Don't** let anything but the grid planes move in response to scroll or pointer.
**Don't** use the legacy `gray-*` / `primary-*` utilities in new code; they exist only so pliny's markup matches the system.
